| description = He is located in the north of the zone next to [[Trankia]] and [[Ristia]]. None of these three NPC's assist each other, and they are all on 22m spawn timers. <s>Very Resistant</s> (only got the occasional resist as a 58, seemed normal enough. he is a wizard so one of his buffs probably gives +10 mr or something), Casts Ice Comet and other powerful wizard spells, but is susceptible to fear (recommend [[Trepidation]]).

If for some reason Sulgar is pulled close enough to [[Tundra Jack]], the Barbarian will lunge into action and attack him. Why? One of EQ's mysteries, it seems...

Attacking him results in him cursing you with something truly vile.... ''infertility!''

 Sulgar says, 'I put a curse upon thee! Thou shalt never sire children!'
